purpose: Fail-closed control-plane protection. protected_roots governs ACCESS: any matching path is denied to standard-builder tasks, and a new file under a protected root is protected from creation. digest_roots governs DIGEST MEMBERSHIP only and never weakens access. A security-maintenance task may touch only the exact paths named in its owner-issued authority artifact. Covered among the trust-granting and CI-executed surfaces: tools/** (registered validators, liveness gates, supervisor, key tooling), tests/** (CI gates on them), requirements-ci.txt and requirements-test-oracle.txt (the two CI supply-chain inputs: what the engine needs to run, and the test-only Bash parser its test jobs add), .bro/policy.json (selects the operating mode) and, since 2026-10-02 by Owner decision (T-153), what the monorepo CI executes from this tree: ci/** (ci/live/run_live_turn.sh and ci/live/run_ladder_turn.sh, which CI runs under sudo, the Python service runners and provisioners those kits stage, ci/isolation_proof.sh, ci/floor_writer_boundary_proof.sh and ci/gen_isolation_fixture.py), install/** (install/brops_install.sh, which CI runs under sudo) and contracts/** (the frozen wire schemas the signer and supervisor services load). All three are both protected and digested, so a __pycache__ under ci/ is a bytecode shadow like any other and a binding issued before a file under them changed no longer verifies. STILL NOT covered, and stated so that 'in full' is not read into this list: '.github/workflows/**' matches only this tree's own copy, which GitHub does not run when engine/ is vendored inside menqstudio/OS -- the workflows that run live at the monorepo root, as do bridge/**, tools/** and apps/** of the monorepo, all outside this manifest's reach because the manifest is rooted at engine/. Bytecode caches (__pycache__/*.pyc) are excluded from the digest by runtime/bro_protected.py, never listed here.
